title: The Last Summit
author: Juniper Brightwater
blurb: Beatrix Villalobos, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
